title: Review Sandbox: cleanup follows proof
audience: Reviewers who need to exercise one repository-declared behavior without touching the primary checkout.
promise: Preview a bounded scenario, create disposable Git state, retain failed or dirty work, and remove only a proven clean workspace.
story: A repository-declared scenario previews its source revision, setup command, run command, and cleanup boundary.
A clean scenario runs and is removed after a clean-worktree proof.
Conflict and failed-setup paths refuse overwrite or skip the scenario instead of hiding the state.
A dirty sandbox is retained for recovery; a cancellation-shaped exit is recorded as a current product limitation.
verified_locally: Preview binds the declared scenario to a target Git revision.
Current-dev clean and failed-setup worktrees are removed only after clean status; failed setup is not run.
Occupied paths are blocked, dirty worktrees are retained and then recovered, and a cancellation-shaped exit is exposed as a limitation.
Source tests, lint, and package checks pass; the 1600x900 PNG/SVG preview was visually reviewed.
open_gates: Add distinct cancellation and process/port ownership receipts, with native cancellation authority.
Prove the complete scenario matrix and primary-checkout readback against a current direct surface without mutating unrelated state.
Verify a hosted no-auth case and read back the external destinations.
Record external GitHub, portfolio, and Handshake readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves a current-dev local sandbox matrix with clean removal, failed setup, dirty recovery, and an explicit cancellation limitation plus a reviewed 1600x900 preview; it does not claim process ownership, port safety, a distinct cancellation state, hosting, or publication.
